name: Momo Belia Deviluke
original_name: モモ・ベリア・デビルーク
source: One of Lala's sisters and Nana's younger twin. She's a sweet girl, but she has lustful tendencies. Especially by sneaking into Rito's room and getting close to him while he's sleeping.
